'''UNA Strassen''', founded in 1922, is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Strassen, Luxembourg]]. The club competes in the {{Luxembourg football updater|UNA4}}

The club plays its home matches at the [[Stade An de Millewisen]], which was inaugurated on 27 October 2025 during a match against [[FC Rodange 91|Rodange 91]]. Prior to this, the team played at the Complexe Sportif Jean Wirtz."}}
